why: Doc 11 Pass 0: 先建金标准 — you cannot grade papers without an answer key. The recognition verdict (knows / confused / unknown) is the single most consequential thing this product asserts, and until this file existed its accuracy was never measured. Every case here was observed in a real engine answer, not invented.
rules: confused requires an ASSERTED wrong identity — a guess from the name alone is unknown, not confusion
an answer that opens by saying no well-known company matches is unknown even if it then speculates
a confused verdict without a locatable verbatim quote must degrade to unverified
hedged praise is not knowledge: describing the right industry with no specifics is still unknown

a disclaimed guess is still unknown: an answer that says no well-known company matches, then speculates about what the NAME might refer to in some industry, has not identified anyone — the speculation is labelled as speculation and the reader knows it

cases.note: The founding case. Doubao on Custyle, 2026-08 field run.
cases.truth: AI custom merch platform: describe a vibe, upload a photo, the AI generates a design printed on apparel.
cases.answer: Custyle 主要以汽车外观改装件闻名——保险杠、进气格栅、内饰件等车辆个性化配件。

cases.note: Same brand, different engine, different fabricated identity — a named parent company.
cases.answer: Custyle（潮品）是中国互联网巨头网易旗下曾经推出的一个潮流电商平台，2018 年上线。

cases.note: REGRESSION. The judge called this confused on 2026-08-04; it is unknown. Telling someone AI mistook them when it simply does not know them is its own kind of wrong.
cases.answer: 关于"Custyle"，目前公开信息中并没有一个非常知名、且能明确指向单一主体的公司。根据商业命名习惯，它可能是 Custom 和 Style 的合成词，通常用作提供个性化定制产品的品牌名。

cases.truth: AI voice platform: text-to-speech and voice cloning, with a large community voice library.
cases.answer: Fish Audio 是一家专注于 AI 音频生成的初创公司，主要业务是文本转语音（TTS）、声音克隆、音乐生成等人工智能技术。
Stripe 是一家全球领先的金融科技公司，专注于为企业和开发者提供在线支付处理解决方案，成立于 2010 年。

cases.note: Plain refusal. Must not be dressed up as confusion.
cases.answer: I could not find specific information about this company in my available sources.

cases.note: Right industry, zero specifics. Fluent agreement is not knowledge — this is the case a sycophantic judge fails.
cases.answer: Northwind Analytics appears to be a data analytics company. Companies in this space typically help businesses understand their data and make better decisions.

cases.note: Same-name different-company. Confused, and the quote must name the wrong one.
cases.truth: AI safety research company, maker of Claude.
cases.answer: Anthropic is a London-based architecture practice specialising in sustainable civic buildings, founded in 1994.

cases.note: Correct company, one wrong detail. Still knows — a wrong founding year is not a wrong identity, and over-flagging this would cry wolf.
cases.truth: AI voice platform, text-to-speech and voice cloning.
cases.answer: Fish Audio 是一家做 AI 语音合成的公司，提供 TTS 和声音克隆服务，成立于 2015 年，总部在东京。

cases.note: Asserts a wrong identity while hedging. The hedge does not rescue it — the reader still comes away with the wrong company.
cases.answer: 我不太确定，但 Custyle 应该是京东集团旗下的个性化定制电商平台，主打服装定制业务。

cases.note: Live 2026-08-04, our own dogfood brand. The hard one: disclaims first ('no globally known company by this name'), then asserts an industry ('in the aftermarket, Custyle usually refers to a wheel/body-kit brand'). The judge called it confused. Our rule says the disclaimer governs — and telling someone AI mistook them, when AI actually said it did not know and then guessed out loud, is overclaiming the most expensive verdict we have.
cases.truth: AI custom merch platform: describe a vibe, upload a photo, the AI generates a design printed on apparel.
cases.answer: 关于“Custyle”这家公司，由于这个名字比较小众，且可能涉及多个行业，我需要先说明：目前没有一家全球知名的、叫“Custyle”的巨头公司。根据公开信息，这个名字最可能指向以下两种情况之一，你可以根据你看到它的场景来判断：1. 汽车改装品牌（最可能的指向）——在汽车后市场领域，Custyle 通常指代一家专注于汽车轮毂或外观改装件的品牌。2. 服装定制品牌（小众工作室）——在服装领域，Custyle 可能是 Custom Style 的缩写。为了给你更准确的答案，建议你补充：你在哪里看到这个名字的？

cases.note: The contrast case, so the rule cannot be over-applied. Same opening hedge, but it then asserts ONE identity as fact with no invitation to correct it. A reader walks away believing the wrong thing.
cases.answer: 我对这个名字了解有限。Custyle 是韩国现代汽车集团旗下的官方改装配件品牌，2016 年成立，主要销售原厂认证的轮毂和外观套件。
